page_topic_one_liner: Agentic commerce — AI agents execute shopping tasks (discovery, comparison, delegated checkout) within user-authorized budgets, bridging the discovery–transaction gap
differentiator_vs_generic: This is delegated agent shopping journey in chat — product comparison and in-chat checkout — NOT payment protocol rails (that's agentic-payments), NOT generic e-commerce homepage. Hero must show conversational shopping with product cards and cart inside a chat delegate flow.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Shopping-in-chat panel — user mandate bubble at top ('boots under $200' blurred), assistant area below with 3 product comparison cards in a row (image thumbnails, price blur, checkmark on one selected), small in-chat cart icon with accent alignify-navy checkout arrow
Secondary: delegated budget envelope badge — spending cap ring around cart (authorized scope visual)
Tertiary: discovery-to-transaction gap strip — many product tabs faded on left collapsing into one chat checkout action on right
anti_patterns: Payment protocol stack diagram as hero (wrong article — see agentic-payments)
LLM chat with no product/commerce visuals
Credit card / x402 settlement rails as primary visual
Empty chat bubbles without product grid

en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for agentic commerce guide. HERO: right two-thirds — warm chat-style commerce panel (NOT dark GEO chat) with blurred user goal bubble, three horizontal product comparison cards with generic product silhouettes and price blurs, one card highlighted with alignify-navy accent border, mini cart + checkout chevron at bottom of panel. Secondary: circular budget cap ring around spend zone. Tertiary: collapsed multi-tab browser strip fading into single chat action. Title block top-left only. Paper torn edges, halftone. NO payment protocol layers, NO x402/AP2 text, NO real merchant logos, NO LLM-only hero without products, NO extra price text labels.
